title: PLANG Configuration
$comment: This is the configuration file for PLANG

debug.$comment: When debug mode is enabled, the messenger will print more information to the console. It also allows the program to keep running even if a critical error occurs. It will still terminate on fatal errors and SDL errors.

add_console_timestamp.$comment: Whether to add a timestamp to the console

print_stacktrace.$comment: Whether to print the stacktrace when an error occurs

logging_enabled.$comment: When the logger is enabled, all messages that are send

log_file_location.$comment: The location of the log file, It should be a relative path.

log_file_limit.$comment: The max amount of log files that can be created before the oldest one is deleted.
